```{r call-libraries} 
library(Giotto)
library(future)
plan('multisession', workers = parallelly::availableCores()-2)
options(future.globals.maxSize= 1e12)
library(scran); library(MAST); library(leiden);   # library(multinet);  
library(data.table)
library(gplots); library(ggplot2); library(viridis)
library(dbscan)
library(dplyr); library(leidenAlg)
sessionInfo()

```

```{r readRDS}
sln <- readRDS("sln.harmony.UMAP.RDS")

```



```{r merge-metadata}
# meta <- fread("../../../Downloads/sln.metadata.csv")                   # executed just one time 
# df <- unique(meta, by = c("sample"))
# df <- df[, list(orig.ident,SLN_Stage,`Path Accession Number`,SLN_Biopsy, SLN_Biopsy_Date, Sex,Age,SLN_Area, Tumor_Area, `Tumor_Greatest_Dimension(mm)`, Histology, `Primary_Breslow(mm)`, Tumor_Infiltrating_Lymphocytes, `Mitoses(mm^2)`, Ulceration, Recurrence, Recurrence_Date, Months_To_Recurrence, Raw_Recur_Group, Death, Chemotherapy_Treatment, Chemotherapy_Treatment_Type, Immunotherapy_Treatment, Immunotherapy_Treatment_Date,Immunotherapy_Treatment_Type)]
# write.csv(df, "sln.metadata.csv")

# sln.save <- sln; save_metadata <- pDataDT(sln);   # save point in case main object gets trashed
# codex_metadata <- save_metadata
df <- fread("sln.metadata.csv")
codex_metadata <- pDataDT(sln)
df$list_ID <- c("ctrl.1","ctrl.2","ctrl.3","ctrl.4","ctrl.5","tumor.1", "tumor.2", "tumor.3","tumor.4", "tumor.5", "tumor.6", "tumor.7", 
                "tumor.8", "tumor.9", "tumor.10")
setcolorder(df, colnames(df)[c(27, 2:26) ]);  df$V1 <- NULL   # clean up column names & order 
new_metadata <- plyr::join(x = codex_metadata, y=df, by= 'list_ID')   # merge the two and duplicate
avoidOverwriting <- c("list_ID", "Object.Id", "Classifier.Label", "x", "y", "nr_feats", "perc_feats", "total_expr", 
                      "leiden_harmony", "trnsfr_leiden_harmony", "trnsfr_leiden_harmony_prob")
new_metadata <- new_metadata[, !avoidOverwriting, with=FALSE]  # leave out columns or else ruins the metadata of the main object
sln <- addCellMetadata(gobject = sln, new_metadata = new_metadata, by_column=T, column_cell_ID = 'cell_ID')

```



```{r plot-UMAP-AllCells}
codex_metadata <- pDataDT(sln) 
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(codex_metadata$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(codex_metadata$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'trnsfr_leiden_harmony',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.75, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.5)


```


```{r plot-UMAP-Downsample}
set.seed(43)
codex_metadata <- pDataDT(sln); keepCells <- subset(codex_metadata, cell_ID %in% sample(codex_metadata$cell_ID, 2e5))$cell_ID
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = keepCells)
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(codex_metadata$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(codex_metadata$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'trnsfr_leiden_harmony',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.75, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.5)

```


```{r cluster-feat-heatmap-AllCells}
markers_scran <- findMarkers_one_vs_all(gobject = sln, method = "scran", expression_values = "normalized",
                                        cluster_column = "trnsfr_leiden_harmony", min_feats = 3)

topgenes_scran <- unique(markers_scran[, head(.SD, 5), by = "cluster"][["feats"]])

plotMetaDataHeatmap(sln, expression_values = "normalized",
                    metadata_cols = "trnsfr_leiden_harmony", selected_feats = topgenes_scran,
                    y_text_size = 8, show_values = "zscores_rescaled")


```



```{r label-L1annotation}

df <- data.frame(trnsfr_leiden_harmony = codex_metadata$trnsfr_leiden_harmony, L1.annot = "Unknown")
df$cell_ID <- codex_metadata$cell_ID
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_harmony %in% c(5,9,15,25,26,28,32,33 )), 'L1.annot'] <- "Tcells"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_harmony %in% c(6,8,18,19 )), 'L1.annot'] <- "Bcells"
df[which(df$trnsfr_leiden_harmony %in% c(20,23 )), 'L1.annot'] <- "Tumor"
sln <- addCellMetadata(sln, new_metadata = df, by_column = T, column_cell_ID="cell_ID")  # add in the annotations to the main object

codex_metadata <- pDataDT(sln)
keepCells <- subset(codex_metadata, cell_ID %in% sample(codex_metadata$cell_ID, 2e5))$cell_ID
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = keepCells)
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(codex_metadata$L1.annot)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(codex_metadata$L1.annot)
plotUMAP(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'L1.annot',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.5, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.35)

```



```{r subset-B-and-T-cells}
gc()
codex_metadata <- pDataDT(sln); keepCells <- codex_metadata$cell_ID[which(codex_metadata$L1.annot == "Tcells")]
Tcells <- subsetGiotto(sln, cell_ids = keepCells )

sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = Tcells, cell_ids = sample(sln$cell_ID, 1e5, replace=F)) # make a smaller dataset to work with 
sln.sm <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
                            name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 10)  # calculate nearest neighbors, focus on global differences 
sln.sm <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = sln.sm, resolution = 0.4, n_iterations = 100, 
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Tcells')  # make the clusters
Tcells <- labelTransfer(x = Tcells, y = sln.sm, labels = "leiden_Tcells")  # assign cluster labels in the full dataset based on the reduced data



# Tcells <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = Tcells, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
#                             name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 15)
# Tcells <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = Tcells, resolution = 0.1, n_iterations = 100, network_name = 'NN.harmony',
#                              name = 'leiden_Tcells')
# Tcells <- runUMAPprojection(Tcells, random_subset = 1e5)  # project UMAP coordinates to the full dataset based on a subsampling
saveRDS(Tcells, "Tcells.UMAP.RDS")

# ************************

keepCells <- codex_metadata$cell_ID[which(codex_metadata$L1.annot == "Bcells")]
Bcells <- subsetGiotto(sln, cell_ids = keepCells )
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = Bcells, cell_ids = sample(sln$cell_ID, 1e5, replace=F)) # make a smaller dataset to work with 
sln.sm <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
                            name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 10)  # calculate nearest neighbors, focus on global differences 
sln.sm <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = sln.sm, resolution = 0.4, n_iterations = 100, 
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Bcells')  # make the clusters
Bcells <- labelTransfer(x = Bcells, y = sln.sm, labels = "leiden_Tcells")  # assign cluster labels in the full dataset based on the reduced data
# 
# Bcells <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = Bcells, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
#                             name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 15)

#                              name = 'leiden_Bcells')
# Bcells <- runUMAPprojection(Bcells, random_subset = 1e5)  # project UMAP coordinates to the full dataset based on a subsampling
saveRDS(Bcells, "Bcells.UMAP.RDS")
```
